title: Three-CNF satisfiability promise problem
statement: For a canonical binary encoding of three-CNF formulas, define a binary promise problem whose yes-instances are exactly the strings encoding satisfiable formulas and whose no-instances are exactly the strings that decode to an unsatisfiable formula. Strings that do not decode as formulas belong to neither set.
hypotheses_covered: A canonical binary encoding of encoded three-CNF formulas
